analyst.summary: SJVN is a government-owned hydropower generator in the middle of a large capacity expansion, and while revenue grew sharply this year, profit actually declined as margins compressed - a sign that the new capacity has not yet translated into proportionate returns. Returns on capital have been falling for years as the company spends heavily ahead of revenue, and cash flow is currently negative. We would wait for the expansion to season and returns to recover before considering this name.
